data.alt: Fencer showing chest circumference and standing height measurements.

fields.title: Chest and height
fields.alt_text: Fencer showing chest circumference and standing height measurements.
fields.instructions:
Chest: Wrap a soft tape around the fullest part of your chest, under your arms. Keep it level and breathe normally.

Height: Stand upright and measure from the floor to the top of your head.

data.alt: Fencer showing where to measure waist and hip circumference.

fields.title: Waist and hips
fields.alt_text: Fencer showing where to measure waist and hip circumference.
fields.instructions:
Waist: Measure around your natural waist.
Hips: Measure around the fullest part of your hips.
Then check your height against the same size.

data.alt: Measuring tape passing beneath the chin and over the crown of the head.

fields.title: Head circumference
fields.alt_text: Measuring tape passing beneath the chin and over the crown of the head.
fields.instructions: Wrap a soft tape under your chin, up one side of your face, over your head, and down the other side to your chin. Keep it snug.

data.alt: Tape around the widest part of the hand below the knuckles, with the thumb outside the loop.

fields.title: Hand circumference
fields.alt_text: Tape around the widest part of the hand below the knuckles, with the thumb outside the loop.
fields.instructions: Wrap a soft tape around the widest part of your fencing hand, just below the knuckles. Keep your thumb outside the loop and the tape snug.

data.alt: Sock measurements: A marks the sole from heel to toe; B marks the leg from heel upwards.

fields.title: Sole and leg length
fields.alt_text: Sock measurements: A marks the sole from heel to toe; B marks the leg from heel upwards.
fields.instructions:
A - Sole length: Measure from your heel to your longest toe.

B - Leg length: Measure from your heel to the height you want above your knee.

fields.title: Mens jackets
fields.fit_advice:
For a close, athletic fit, choose the size that matches your measurements. Choose one size larger for extra shoulder room or a looser layer underneath.

Lamé jackets fit over a fencing jacket of the same size. No extra sizing adjustment is needed.

fields.title: Mens pants
fields.fit_advice: If your hips fall in a larger size range, choose that size for room to move. Between sizes, choose larger for more room or smaller for a closer fit.

fields.title: Mens chest protectors
fields.fit_advice: Choose the larger size when your chest measurement falls between two sizes.

fields.title: Masks
fields.fit_advice: Between sizes, choose the larger size. If your mask feels loose or tight, ask your coach or an experienced teammate to help adjust it before exchanging sizes.

fields.title: Gloves
fields.fit_advice: Choose the larger size when your hand measurement falls between two sizes.

fields.title: Standard socks
fields.fit_advice: Shoe sizes are US Mens sizes. The length columns give the sock's sole (A) and leg (B) measurements. If you're between sizes, choose the larger size.
